alt_title: Indian Homes Hold 3× More Gold Than the US Government
description: Indian homes and temples hold about 25,000 tonnes of gold, by a World Gold Council estimate (reported as 23,537 to 25,537 tonnes by September 2024). That is about three times the US government's 8,134 tonnes (US Treasury, 30 Sep 2026: 261,498,926 fine troy ounces; tonnes are our conversion), and over 25 times the RBI's 880.52 tonnes (end-March 2026).
Household gold is an estimate, not a count. Dhanteras is on 6 November.
question: How much of your savings is gold?
x: Indian homes and temples hold about 25,000 tonnes of gold (World Gold Council estimate). The US government: 8,134 t. The RBI: 880.52 t. Homes hold about 3× the US government's gold and over 25× the RBI's. Sources: WGC estimate, US Treasury, RBI.
